rationale: The Logic section remains abstract with respect to the relevant patch delta. Both implementations reject zero-sized input and modifications to other tasks, require a null-terminated command buffer before parsing, process supported attribute/command combinations, invoke profile-related handlers, and return the input size on successful completion. Although the fixed version changes how a non-null-terminated buffer is handled (allocating a temporary terminated copy rather than writing into the supplied buffer), the docstring does not specify either mechanism. Its broad statement about logging on failure is not an accurate exhaustive characterization of either version, but it does not unambiguously identify the vulnerable or fixed behavior.
